Paste a passport-size coloured photo on the form.
Write the name of the District or Taluka Family Court where you want to be empanelled (Sri Muktsar Sahib, Malout or Gidderbaha).
Fill in your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email address.
Give your educational qualifications from the Bachelor's degree onwards: exam, university, year of passing and percentage of marks.

Submit the form with your testimonials to the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Sri Muktsar Sahib, before 5:00 PM on 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Muktsar Family Court
content_sections.text: The Family Court of District Sri Muktsar Sahib in Punjab hears disputes relating to marriage and family affairs. It also has cluster Family Courts at Malout and Gidderbaha. Its Principal Judge issued this notice to empanel counselors under the Punjab Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2024.

content_sections.heading: Muktsar Family Court Family Counselor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be at least 35 years old on the last date for submitting applications, 11 November 2026. Candidates must meet the qualification by the last date of application. Mandatory: a graduate degree from a recognized University. Preferred subjects: Social Science/Sociology, Psychology or Clinical Psychiatry as one of the subjects, or law. Candidates need at least 02 (two) years of experience in the field of Social Work/Welfare. Instead, they can have links with field work, research or teaching in Government Departments, a College, a University or a similar academic institute in family welfare or the problems of women and children. Candidates must have impeccable integrity. If all other things are equal, preference goes to: a woman candidate with the requisite qualification; a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of counseling in family matters. In exceptional circumstances, the High Court may relax the minimum academic qualifications. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of a Family Counselor
content_sections.text: Work with the Family Court to promote conciliation and secure speedy settlement of disputes about marriage, family affairs and connected matters. Not act or plead for any party to a case, but help the Court reach a peaceful and amicable settlement. Attend the Court whenever the Judge of the Family Court requires it. Aid and advise the parties on settling the dispute or any part of it, and help them reconcile. Submit a report or interim report when the Court requires one. Perform any other functions the Family Court assigns from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice lists an interaction with candidates on 18 November 2026. No TA/DA will be paid for attending. The Hon'ble High Court appoints the panel of counselors on the recommendation of the Principal Judge of the Family Court.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: empanelment as a Counselor in the Family Court of District Sri Muktsar Sahib and the cluster Family Courts at Malout and Gidderbaha. Term: three years. The Hon'ble High Court can extend it on the recommendation of the Principal Judge of the Family Court. Removal: the Hon'ble High Court may remove a counselor's name from the panel at any time before the term ends, without prior notice, on the recommendation of the Principal Judge, Family Court.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Muktsar Family Court Family Counselor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and take the application form attached to it ("Application for Appointment of Counsellor"). Paste a passport-size coloured photo on the form. Write the name of the District or Taluka Family Court where you want to be empanelled (Sri Muktsar Sahib, Malout or Gidderbaha). Fill in your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email address. Give your educational qualifications from the Bachelor's degree onwards: exam, university, year of passing and percentage of marks. Give details of your experience in Social and Family Welfare, as required under Rule 6(B) and 6(C) of the Punjab Family Courts (Amendment) Rules, 2024. If you are enrolled as an Advocate, write your enrollment number. If you have worked as a Counselor in a Family Court before, give the court and the year. Answer whether any criminal prosecution is pending against you, whether you have ever been convicted by a criminal court, and whether any case concerning you is pending in this Family Court. Sign the declaration and add the date and place. Submit the form with your testimonials to the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Sri Muktsar Sahib, before 5:00 PM on 11 November 2026. faq.question: Q1. Where are the Family Counselor posts located?
faq.answer: There is one post at the Headquarter at Sri Muktsar Sahib and one each at Camp Court Malout and Camp Court Gidderbaha.

faq.question: Q2. Is there a minimum age for this job?
faq.answer: Yes. You must be at least 35 years old on the last date for applications.

faq.question: Q3. Which graduation subjects are preferred?
faq.answer: Social Science/Sociology, Psychology or Clinical Psychiatry as one of the subjects, or law. Any graduate degree from a recognized University meets the basic requirement.

faq.question: Q4. Who gets preference in selection?
faq.answer: If all other things are equal, preference goes to a woman candidate with the requisite qualification, and to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of counseling in family matters.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the counselor's term?
faq.answer: Three years. The Hon'ble High Court can extend it on the recommendation of the Principal Judge of the Family Court.

faq.question: Q6. When is the interaction?
faq.answer: On 18 November 2026. Candidates do not get any TA/DA for attending.

faq.question: Q7. Where do I submit the application?
faq.answer: Submit the form with your testimonials to the office of the District & Sessions Judge, Sri Muktsar Sahib, before 5:00 PM on 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can a practising advocate apply?
faq.answer: The form asks applicants who are enrolled as Advocates to give their enrollment number. Once appointed, a counselor must not act or plead for any party to a case before the court.

faq.question: Q9. What does the form ask about criminal cases?
faq.answer: You must say whether any criminal prosecution is pending against you, whether you have ever been convicted by a criminal court, and whether any case concerning you is pending in this Family Court.
